title: Value-iteration field over tiles
question: Does a value-iteration field over tiles, which weighs every reachable target by reward and path cost, move units better than goal()'s single nearest target?
change: Each move of a walking unit adds field times the gain in the field value phi from its tile to the target tile; phi is the best reachable reward minus path cost, solved by value iteration each decision.
method: Strength sweep, 200 games per point against each panel model, final test 400 games

runs.label: The base (experiment 11), final test on the same maps
